method: Fresh browser profile and disabled cache per observation, fixed five-second post-onboarding window, blocked external network. Same browser/build tooling on main and unchanged C1 runtime plus lossless pixel packing. Record all observations; no reroll. Three observations/config are a diagnostic, not statistical equivalence. Native shared lock per observation, closed browser/server at each boundary, at least7seconds handoff. All runtime/source/asset files unchanged.
